我们需要研发新科技。新世界协议将使我们可以建造£colony_ship£殖民船，如果我们要扩张自己的帝国，那我们应该尽快研发它。

点击顶部界面左端的按钮或是按下F4键来开启科技界面。然后点击选择研究并从中挑选一项科技作为研究目标。
texts.en:
We need to research new technologies. The New Worlds Protocol will enable us to construct £colony_ship£ Colony Ships, and we should focus on this as soon as possible if we are to expand our empire.

Access the Technology screen by clicking its button in the left section of the top bar or by pressing F4. Then click on Select Research and pick a technology to pursue from the options available.
